Nina Bose: Hey folks — first day! Quick intro: I'm Nina (she/her), joining infra eng. Two quick things: 1) where do I put my plant order (I have a tiny cactus request) and 2) I'm hitting `Permission denied (publickey)` when trying to SSH to the bastion: `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_rsa nina@bastion.redwood`. Any tips? :wave:
Alejandro Cruz: Welcome Nina!! For plants ping @Emma (people-ops) — she'll sort desk deliveries and stickers. For SSH, make sure you uploaded your public key to the onboarding portal (https://onboard.redwood.example/keys). Also confirm the key name matches what's in your local `~/.ssh/config`.
Kimberly Tran: hey @Nina Bose — +1 to uploading the pubkey. Also our infra prefers ed25519 keys. Try `ssh -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519 nina@bastion.redwood -v` to see the debug output. If you paste the `-v` lines we can spot the problem quickly. I can hop on in 10 if needed. :computer:
Emma (people-ops): Welcome!! I'll order a small cactus for you unless you'd rather a low-light fern. DM me preferences and desk location. Sticker pack incoming. :tada:
Devex Bot: New user added: Nina Bose -> groups: #eng, #new-hires, #oncall. Onboarding checklist email sent to nina@redwood.example.
Kimberly Tran: Also FYI, there's a quick team lunch at 12:30 in the kitchen — it's low-key, stop by if you want to meet folks. :bento:
Alejandro Cruz: If you want a mentor, @Ops-Mentor is paired this week for infra newbies. They can do a walkthrough of our bastion/SSO flow.
Ops-Mentor: hey @Nina Bose! congrats and welcome. I can do a 30m walkthrough today at 3pm or 10am tomorrow. Which works for you?
Nina Bose: Thanks everyone — 3pm works great for me. I'll switch to ed25519 and try again; if still broken I'll paste the `-v` output here. Cactus preferred :seedling: See you at lunch! :smile:
